title: On Call HVACR Repair and Maintenance Services
agency_path: City of New York > District Attorney - New York County
description_text: The New York County District Attorneys Office (DANY) is awarding the contractor, Americare Appliance Repair LLC for On Call HVACR Repair and Maintenance Services with the contract amount of $83,335.00, The term is for two years from the date of registration, may renew for one additional year for a total term of three years. The contract was awarded under PIN 20271800901. The awarded vendor was selected pursuant to the M/WBE Small Purchase Method, Section 3-08(c)(1)(iv) of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, deemed responsible and able to meet all requirements of this contract.
